reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for structured Docker and Docker Compose control, including container inspection, logs, execution, lifecycle management, project-aware targeting, health context, and approval-gated destructive operations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化且具项目感知能力的 Docker 与 Docker Compose 容器管理、诊断和受控执行工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with structured, project-aware Docker and Docker Compose tools for container management, diagnostics, health context, and guarded execution.

capabilities: Invokes the Docker CLI through the host integration seam
Reads structured container, image, Compose service, inspection, and log data
Starts, stops, restarts, removes, and prunes Docker resources
Creates and tears down Docker Compose stacks
Runs docker exec commands with read-only behavior by default and optional write or interactive execution
Provides optional Compose service-health context and structured web status rendering
